dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline with moderate curvature on the trailing edge, originating from a wide dorsal base and tapering toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, exhibiting an obtuse transition between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex curve with a large radius fitting the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, low-profile rostrum with a length significantly less than the melon's vertical thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle (approximately 160-170 degrees) where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights creating a distinct bi-level longitudinal band of light pixels along the mid-lateral flank.
